description: riverwood-walk timed for the macOS native build on the M1 (main menu up by frame 300, Riverwood loaded by frame 2100): coc into Riverwood, stand for 10 s, run forward for 20 s. Default character, no save. One console command only: keys typed within about 1.5 s after a Return are dropped (observed). At frame 2150 the console is reopened for `bat benchwx` (benchwx.txt: fw then sw 0000081A, SkyrimClear), so every run has the same clear sky: the region's weather is otherwise picked at random per run, and overcast runs draw about 57 more effect draws per frame (measured in Riverwood on the M5).
